DIAGNOSIS READY: Patellar Tendinitis (Jumper's Knee)

The history of recent volleyball, repetitive pivoting, and worsening pain over 24 hours is highly suggestive of a tendinopathy. To confirm the diagnosis and rule out a partial tear, I will need to examine your knee. Can you please rate your pain on a scale of 1 to 10 and tell me if the pain is located directly in front of your knee or below it?
